title: VTG Playboy Magazine July 1986 Complete With Centerfold Carrie Leigh
descriptionText: The product is a vintage issue of Playboy Magazine from July 1986, featuring Carrie Leigh on the centerfold. This collectible magazine offers a glimpse into the historical and cultural landscape of the 1980s, providing readers with a mix of entertainment, lifestyle, and informative content. As a prized possession for collectors of vintage Playboy magazines, this issue showcases the iconic Playboy brand and the array of popular culture and sensibilities of the time.
